$comment: The one place the concierge's character lives. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the app (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file. To change the character: change `character` (an avatar character id; the idle dock's still photo is frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp), `name`, and each language's `voice`. `roles` is the dock's label per tab (`role` when a tab has none). Languages: only the ones listed are offered; with one, the app shows no language toggle and the brain has no language switch. To add a language: add an entry under `languages` (BCP-47 tag) with its label, name, voice, greeting and switch line, add the tag to frontend/src/stage/scene.json's `languages`, and give the brain its written lines (backend/lines.py). A voice must speak the language it is listed under (see GET https://app.voqalize.com/api/v1/catalog.get).
